facts.fact: UNESCO's PEER profile says the document 'Politique et stratégie nationales de développement des TIC' was developed in 2010 by the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and New Information Technologies, and reports later initiatives launched in line with it (the profile does not use the word adopted).
facts.system: Politique et stratégie nationales de développement des TIC

facts.fact: The profile says the 2010 ICT policy and strategy was developed by the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and New Information Technologies, which it describes as responsible for the government's telecommunications and digital economy policy.
facts.system: Politique et stratégie nationales de développement des TIC

facts.fact: The profile says the 2010 ICT policy and strategy proposed a national initiative of one computer per secondary pupil, higher-education student and teacher, and set six aims (legal and institutional framework, basic infrastructure, human capacity, ICT applications, public-private partnerships, regional cooperation), with no cost or dates stated.
facts.system: Politique et stratégie nationales de développement des TIC

facts.fact: The profile says a national information and communication infrastructure development plan covered the years 2001 to 2004, preceding the 2010 ICT policy.
facts.system: Plan de développement de l'infrastructure nationale d'information et de communication
